text:
ana: Weekend poll — rooftop picnic with skyline sunset + portable speakers Saturday evening OR early-morning campfire at Pine Ridge Sunday? Which vibes are we doing? :city_sunset: vs :camping:
ryan: Rooftop for me. Low effort, good view, less bugs. Saturday sounds perfect.
samira: Campfire all the way. I need trees, a fire, and an excuse to play ukulele. I'll bring marshmallows. :fire:
chris: I can do rooftop if someone brings a decent speaker. My phone speaker is tragic. :grimacing:
devin: I have a JBL and battery pack I can bring. Also a tiny propane grill if crab cakes are considered picnic food. :crab:
ana: (oops typo - meant ana) Logistics check: rooftop might need a building RSVP for groups >6. Pine Ridge campfire rules: only in designated rings, bring no-ground-fire supplies. Quick schedule snippet:
``
Rooftop: Sat 5:30pm - 9:30pm. RSVP by Fri 5pm.
Campfire: Sun 7pm - 10pm. Meet Pine Ridge lot 6:15pm.
``
ryan: Good to know. Kids/partners welcome?
samira: Partners welcome. I'll bring a small playlist (folk + mellow indie). :notes:
chris: RSVP me for rooftop. I'll sign up to bring salads or a veggie platter.
devin: I'll bring the speaker + grill. If campfire wins I can bring extra firewood (pending regs).
ana: Quick vote: rooftop -> :one:, campfire -> :two:, split (some rooftop, some campfire) -> :three:.
ryan: :one:
samira: :two:
chris: :one:
devin: :three:
ana: Rooftop edge. I'll RSVP with building and make a google sheet for food/gear. Tagging @here in case anyone else wants in. See you this weekend! :sparkles:
